text: This staff report is about a matter for which the Community Council has delegated authority from City Council to make a final decision. The purpose of this report is to amend the Municipal Code, Chapter 950, Schedule 27, Compulsory Stops, to reflect a stop control sign for northbound traffic on Custead Court at the intersection of Burnhamill Place, which was installed by the developer.
Etobicoke York Community Council: 1. Authorized the installation of a stop control for northbound traffic on Custead Court at the intersection of Burnhamill Place.
